title: Fix Tailwind content scanning to include JSON schema files
body:
Tailwind was not scanning JSON schema files in the playground, causing classes defined in JSON to be excluded from the CSS bundle.

## Changes

- Updated `content` array in `apps/playground/tailwind.config.js` to include `.json` extension
- Updated `content` array in `examples/prototype/tailwind.config.js` to include `.json` extension

```diff
  content: [
    "./index.html",
-   "./src/**/*.{js,ts,jsx,tsx}",
+   "./src/**/*.{js,ts,jsx,tsx,json}",
    "../../packages/components/src/**/*.{js,ts,jsx,tsx}",
  ],
```

## Context

The playground stores UI component schemas in JSON files (e.g., `src/data/examples/forms/form-demo.json`) with extensive Tailwind classes:

```json
{
  "type": "div",
  "className": "min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-50 via-purple-50 to-pink-50",
  "body": [...]
}
```

Without scanning these JSON files, Tailwind purges these classes from the production build, leaving components unstyled.
